a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly can't finish. The reserve has only 4, which is enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. I know this departs from our agreement. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both fail, so consider that before you choose.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take any more cells.
